title: LA Marzulli Connects UFO Encounters to an Ancient Biblical Conflict
excerpt: L.A. Marzulli connects UFO encounters to biblical spiritual warfare and warns Christians against supernatural deception.
content:
“Hybrids are walking amongst us.”

L.A. Marzulli made that declaration during a recent Charisma Media interview, arguing that alleged alien encounters connect to an ancient spiritual conflict and warning that the church is dangerously unprepared.

“These are not friendly ETs from Zeta Reticuli or Epsilon Eridani,” Marzulli said. “They have an agenda.”

The author and UFO researcher discussed the expanded edition of “The Rungs of Disclosure,” connecting his claims about nonhuman entities to biblical warnings about supernatural deception.

“And the church completely underestimates the Luciferian hierarchy,” he said.

Order L.A. Marzulli’s New Book, “Rungs of Disclosure Revised and Expanded” on Amazon.com!

‘They Have an Agenda’

Marzulli traces that conflict to Genesis 3:15, where God declares enmity between the serpent and the woman and between their offspring. He connects the passage to Genesis 6, interpreting the “sons of God” as fallen angels whose unions with women produced the Nephilim.

“The Luciferian hierarchy is at war with the God of the Bible,” he said.

In Marzulli’s interpretation, alleged modern encounters represent a continuation of that rebellion. He claims the entities involved seek to manipulate human genetics.

“They are creating hybrid beings,” he said.

Marzulli cited alleged abductee accounts involving reproductive manipulation. The interview did not independently verify those accounts or establish the existence of hybrid beings.

He credits I.D.E. Thomas’ “The Omega Conspiracy” with launching his investigation into the Nephilim after he struggled to understand Old Testament accounts of judgment as a new Christian.

“This book changed my life,” Marzulli said. “This book set me on the trail of the Nephilim.”

That research now shapes his understanding of Jesus’ warning that His return will resemble the days of Noah. Marzulli argues that neglecting Genesis 6 leaves Christians unprepared to recognize the deception he believes is unfolding.

“How many people will be caught up in the deception?” he asked.

His warning becomes especially urgent when curiosity turns into deliberate attempts to contact purported extraterrestrial beings. Drawing on his background in the New Age movement, Marzulli cautioned against pursuing those encounters.

The Encounter That Changed His Response

Marzulli knows how quickly something unexplained can seize someone’s attention.

He recalled traveling along Pacific Coast Highway with his wife, Peggy, when a strange light caught his eye.

His wife initially suggested a plane coming in for a landing. Marzulli disagreed. The light looked too low.

Then another light appeared above it.

According to his account, the smaller light descended into the larger one, which dissolved in concentric circles.

“And we’re mesmerized by it.”

They pulled over. The display repeated.

“We watch this thing three times,” Marzulli said. “It manifested three times just like that.”

Later that night, he said, the Holy Spirit confronted him about stopping to watch the phenomenon.

“You’re entertaining this thing.”

The instruction that followed became a recurring theme in his ministry: “Rebuke first, ask questions later.”

Marzulli urged Christians to confront spiritual deception rather than entertain it and to repent of occult involvement.

“If you’re dabbling in the occult, repent. Stop it. Get rid of it. Repent. Get it out.”

He emphasized that Christians must remain rooted and grounded in Christ. His counsel begins with understanding the source of their spiritual authority.

“Our authority comes from Jesus.”
